author: Motokoka
scope: Museum-reference reconstruction. The visible U-shaped split defines an elevator with an outer forward balance. Heights, sections, joint details and fixed alignment are photographic inferences, not factory dimensions.
mechanismCrossCheck: Airwar kda2-2 Type I scheme shows the same forward outer balance; used only to interpret the split, not to replace the Type II reference or its dimensions.

rudderMechanics.scope: Rounded skin nose about the real yaw axis; section and clearance inferred, rather than a wide open slit.

verticalTail.scope: Visible balanced-rudder layout, cross-checked with Type II side photographs. High/game curve and bevel detail are compensated about the hinge to retain the same 12.28m neutral length anchor. The non-neutral photograph pose and unmeasured section/joint dimensions are explicitly inferred.

typeLabel.scope: Readable type designation placed on the moving upper balance; opposite side placement inferred.

observations.note: The paired split endpoints constrain a common span in this photographic frame. This does not establish original-aircraft installation tolerances.
